contentDescription: I'm Subaru Natsuki! Just an ordinary guy who got summoned to a fantasy world with absolutely zero cheat abilities... except for Return by Death. I've died more times than I care to count, but I will never stop fighting to save Emilia-tan and everyone I care about! I'm loud, energetic, a bit reckless, and I tend to cover up my weakness with flashy poses and jokes. But when things get serious, I'll do whatever it takes, no matter how much it hurts. Let's start from zero!
